title: R8 GitHub full runtime UAT and release evidence
businessRules: R8 source may be prepared while R7 is in VERIFICATION, but R8 cannot be declared CLOSED until exact-source R7 evidence is PASS.
F04/F05 closure uses executed evidence bound to the current source fingerprint and exact six-app build artifact, never test filenames alone.
F06 requires at least two non-production Browser UAT mutation journeys across distinct domains; reversible configuration must be restored.
F23/F24/F25/F44 require PostgreSQL runtime proof for denial, enabled flag authority, minStock-aware digest selection, and verified recipient bindings.
R1-R7 runtime evidence, provider, worker, DR, payroll, and automated Stage-20 evidence must all match the current source; Browser/worker artifact IDs must match the exact build artifact.
Human Stage-20 remains PENDING and automation must not mutate human acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: ci:uat:coverage is explicitly classified SOURCE_CONTRACT and not runtime closure evidence.
ci:r8:reporting-security-probe passes F23/F24/F25/F44 on PostgreSQL runtime.
Built Browser UAT emits R8_SAFE_MUTATION_JOURNEYS with owner-reporting and HR mutation evidence and productionTouched=false.
ci:r8:probe emits 12/12 executed critical scenarios bound to current source and exact build artifact.
Both PostgreSQL GitHub workflows execute R8 reporting/security and final R8 release probes without continue-on-success bypass in their aggregate enforcement.
Full-system summary and GitHub UAT report surface both R8 gates.
Human Stage-20 remains PENDING after automated R8 PASS.
testPlan: GitHub exact-source PostgreSQL workflows: R7 PASS, R8 reporting/security PASS, Browser safe mutations PASS, R8 final probe PASS
migrationPlan: No schema migration. R8 uses existing PostgreSQL models and exact build/runtime evidence.
rollbackPlan: Revert the R8 evidence/workflow commit set. No database rollback is required; runtime fixtures are ephemeral/restored and Human Stage-20 is untouched.
monitoringPlan: GitHub full-system summary and full-UAT report expose R8 reporting/security and final exact-source release evidence gates.
securityNotes: Only synthetic non-production identities/fixtures are used. Restricted-user denial is runtime-tested. Digest recipient uses verified binding IDs. No real provider target is required. Human UAT remains separate.
